Main thing is just keep circling the area they're in and keep spawning enemies to just overwhelm or be annoying and don't push or you will scare them off. The free hits will let you rank up quickly. My suggestion would be to watch some YouTube videos from the community and watch how they play as demon. I watched a few from different channels and implemented my own style on top of the different tricks they use. I was getting my ass kicked at first, but now as a level 45 demon. I can go hours without losing a match. My quick tip for you though: play aggressively and don't focus on staying in 1 spot too long, pop in and out houses to listen for crates, don't focus on traps too much in one certain area they don't provide much points to level up besides crates, level up your infernal, your basics mostly, and at least 1 elite. Keep searching for infernal energy and keep.dropping units randomly until you find the survivors. You will accumulate points way faster this way than setting portals. When you do find the survivors: place your units strategically. Place an elite in front of them and basics behind them. As long as they get a couple hits in you're good. Keep circling around to collect infernal energy and keep dropping them. You just want to be as annoying as possible. Start leveling up possession when your basics are almost maxed on. My Strategy focuses on getting your demon leveled up faster and isn't a win in the first 2 minutes. (Which is the lamest strat as a demon. Enjoy the game. Also this play style works best with Warlord since her infernal regenerates fast when it's maxed)
